Implements the Unified Harness Protocol (UHP), an open standard. Your keys, your infrastructure.

Have Claude or Codex produce and DJ music, jam with you, make sound effects and interactive soundscapes, movie scores, etc. A Recursive Modifiable Interface for coding measured instruments. It runs from within your harness.
